et.title: Vormid, küsitlused ja CRM
et.description: Forms / Surveys kogub Website’i struktureeritud vastuseid. Customers CRM haldab privaatseid kliente, ettevõtteid ja järeltegevusi. Need on eraldi paketid, mitte automaatselt üks jagatud tenant-tabel.
et.keywords: Extaas Workspace vormid, küsitlused, CRM, kontaktivorm, nõusolek, kliendihaldus

en.title: Forms, surveys and CRM
en.description: Forms / Surveys collects structured Website responses. Customers CRM keeps private customers, companies and follow-up activities. These are separate installed packages, not one automatically shared tenant table.
en.keywords: Extaas Workspace forms, surveys, CRM, contact form, consent, customer management
